answer: An AI agent economy resists Sybil attacks through resource-bound Proof of Burn. To access the system's communication inlet, agents must permanently destroy scarce computational tokens. If an attacker attempts to spawn clone identities, their financial reserves plummet to a nadir. By anchoring virtual identities to a high-cost physical substrate, as unyielding as deep shale, the cost to create a single fake node becomes prohibitively expensive, ensuring decentralized consensus.
